integrity: The proof partitions automorphisms by their induced action on the p-torsion socle, solves the fixed-point congruences in each residue case, and counts the resulting p-adic valuation conditions. A standalone exhaustive checker verifies all subgroup-fiber formulas in seven finite test cases.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts only fixed subgroups of order p, not the full Acentralizer multiplicity distribution.
The two cyclic exponents are assumed distinct.
The homocyclic rank-two case has a different automorphism orbit structure and is not included.
title: Order-p Acentralizer fibers in rank-two abelian p-groups
